title: the grass field goes still, then the wind returns
story: A warm terracotta field of grass moves on a swung 113 bpm groove: each strong onset sends a gust through it and the bright hits light the tips. At 4008 the band drops out (RMS -2.4 sd): the wind dies, the field stands still and darkens, and only the isolated hits 4049, 4177, 4195 and 4229 each turn the gust in a new direction, flash the tips and push the camera. From 4230 the band returns, the growth steps up and the wind comes back stronger than before, gusting on every hit, with the 4353 and 4464 accents smaller.
